connection_failed_hint: Make sure the remote server has a VNC server running (e.g. TigerVNC, x11vnc) and the SSH connection details are correct.
vnc_auth_failed_password_hint: VNC authentication failed. Please check your password.
connection_lost_detailed:
Connection lost. Possible causes:
• VNC server not running
• SSH tunnel disconnected
• Network issue
vnc_hint: The remote server needs a VNC server running. Common ports: 5900 (display :0), 5901 (display :1). If VNC is password-protected, enter it in the VNC Password field.
ai_assistant_always_hint: Install/configure VNC, change passwords, check port usage, explain commands — just ask.
open_ai_assistant_failed: Failed to open the AI assistant. Please check that an AI model is configured.
x11_mode_hint: X11 Forwarding: No VNC required, forwards graphical apps directly. Requires XQuartz on macOS. Best for running single graphical programs. (Not supported on Windows — use VNC mode.)
vnc_mode_hint: VNC Desktop: Requires VNC server on remote, provides full desktop environment. Best for complete GUI sessions.
x11_hint: Run graphical applications in this terminal (e.g. xclock, firefox). Windows will appear on your local X11 server.
password_setup_desc: VNC password protects your remote desktop connection from unauthorized access.
password_stored_remotely: Password will be stored in ~/.vnc/passwd on the remote server
password_required_on_connect: You'll need this password every time you connect
password_min_length: Password must be at least 6 characters (TigerVNC requirement)
password_security_tip: Use a strong password with letters, numbers, and special characters
password_connect_desc: Enter the VNC password set on the remote server to establish connection.
password_connect_hint: This password was set via vncpasswd command on the remote server.
password_manual_desc: This VNC server does not support automatic password setup. Run the command below in the terminal to set the password, then click Continue.
password_manual_note: After running the command above in the terminal, click Continue to proceed.
reset_password_desc: Set a new VNC password on the remote server.
reset_password_warning_desc: This will overwrite the existing VNC password on the remote server. After setting, use the new password to connect.
restart_vnc_after_password_reset: Password changed. VNC server needs to restart to use the new password. Click to restart.
setup_guide_desc: Follow the steps to set up VNC
rd_flavor_none_desc: Install VNC server only; desktop falls back to xterm
rd_flavor_desktop_desc: Install the full Xfce desktop environment (with common app suite)
rd_redo_confirm_desc: This re-runs the step's command on the remote server (may reinstall packages / restart the VNC service). Continue?
rd_reset_confirm_desc: This will uninstall VNC and related components on the remote server, clean the ~/.vnc configuration directory, then reinstall VNC and the desktop environment. Continue?
